core_obligations: Use the etale local criterion for the vanishing of higher direct images to reduce to the case where $Y$ is the spectrum of a Noetherian ring (proof lines 3826-3829).
Note that then $X$ is a scheme, being a closed subspace of projective space over an affine base (proof lines 3829-3830).
Apply the scheme case of the vanishing statement to obtain the integer $d_0$ (proof lines 3830-3831).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to an affine Noetherian base (proof lines 3826-3829).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that twisting a coherent module on a closed subspace of projective space by powers of the pulled back tautological bundle kills all higher direct images along the projection once the power is large enough (statement lines 3808-3823). The proof uses the etale local character of the vanishing to reduce to a Noetherian affine base, where the subspace becomes a scheme, and then quotes the scheme case. The reduction to the scheme situation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
